key.name: toggle-writer
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that starts or quits the ALPHA Writer screen tool.

key.name: toggle-launcher
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens or dismisses the ALPHA Quick Launcher search HUD.

key.name: toggle-ask
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens the ALPHA Ask prompt HUD.

key.name: toggle-snip
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that starts a region snip and explains it.

key.name: toggle-clipboard
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens the searchable clipboard history HUD.

key.name: toggle-clipboard-ai
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that runs an AI action on the current clipboard text.

key.name: toggle-terminal-assist
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that turns a description into a reviewable shell command.

key.name: toggle-zoom
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that enters or leaves presentation zoom and spotlight mode.

key.name: toggle-recorder
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that starts or stops screen recording.

key.name: toggle-focus
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that mutes notifications and dims the top bar.

key.name: enable-ask
key.description: Whether the ALPHA Ask feature is available.

key.name: enable-snip
key.description: Whether the Snip & Explain feature is available.

key.name: enable-clipboard
key.description: Whether clipboard history is recorded and browsable.

key.name: enable-clipboard-ai
key.description: Whether the Clipboard AI feature is available.

key.name: enable-terminal-assist
key.description: Whether the Terminal Assist feature is available.

key.name: enable-zoom
key.description: Whether the Zoom & Spotlight feature is available.

key.name: enable-recorder
key.description: Whether the screen recorder feature is available.

key.name: enable-stats
key.description: Whether the system stats indicator is shown in the top bar.

key.name: enable-focus
key.description: Whether the Focus Mode feature is available.

key.name: provider
key.description: Identifier of the AI provider to use (empty until a provider is wired).

key.name: model
key.description: Identifier of the AI model to use (empty until a provider is wired).
